label: [ K-IG 교육- 254]

blocks.text: Our country has many places to visit such as Gyeong-ju,
Bulguk-Temple, Mt. Halla and the Korea Folk Village.
The most historical attraction in Korea is the city of Gyeong-ju.
Gyeong-ju was the ancient capital of the Shilla Kingdom.
The Shilla Kingdom was at its most powerful during the 8th century.
Many people refer to Gyeong-ju as a museum without walls
because it contains many old remains of the Shilla Dynasty.
Another popular place to visit is Mt. Halla on the island of Jeju.
It is located near the center of the island,
and it is South Korea’s tallest mountain,
I would like to visit these marvelous places someday.
